name: por-threshold-mc
description: Issue #15's Monte Carlo local-mismatch sweep of design/por_comparator.spice (idealised 500 nA IBIAS / 1.2 V VREF, same cell-level DUT sim/por-comparator-designer-check/ uses): comparator input-pair offset and resistor-divider-ratio mismatch contribution to #por-vth-rise, #por-vth-fall and #por-hysteresis, each at its own spec-ratified binding (process corner, temperature, rail) point from sim/por-vth/'s (#14) measured record.
claim: spec/target-spec.md#por-vth-rise, #por-vth-fall, #por-hysteresis -- local-mismatch share, Monte Carlo, N>=500 per binding point, evaluated at each row's own named binding corner (5 distinct (process, temp, rail) points across the three rows -- see mc.binding_points below). Complements the deterministic systematic/corner share published by sim/por-vth/ (#14).
analyses: meas tran vpor_rise find v(vdd) when v(por_raw)=1.5 rise=1
meas tran vpor_rise_last find v(vdd) when v(por_raw)=1.5 rise=last
meas tran vpor_fall find v(vdd) when v(por_raw)=1.5 fall=1
meas tran vpor_fall_last find v(vdd) when v(por_raw)=1.5 fall=last
meas tran sns_rise find v(xdut.sns) when v(por_raw)=1.5 rise=1
meas tran sns_fall find v(xdut.sns) when v(por_raw)=1.5 fall=1

vpor_rise_v.description: spec/target-spec.md#por-vth-rise ([3sigma], 2.47/2.60/2.73 V). WITH local mismatch on -- mismatch-inclusive counterpart to sim/por-vth/'s deterministic-corners-only vpor_rise_v check. Full ratified window checked at every binding point; the point named 'vth-rise-max'/'vth-rise-min' is where each edge of the window is expected to bind, per sim/por-vth/'s measured record.

vpor_fall_v.description: spec/target-spec.md#por-vth-fall ([3sigma], 2.22/2.45/2.63 V), same construction as vpor_rise_v above.

v_hys_mv.description: spec/target-spec.md#por-hysteresis ([3sigma], 100/150/250 mV). Both edges measured on the SAME die (one xdut instance, one triangle-wave ramp) -- see stimulus.spice for why that is load-bearing under mismatch.
